newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-Pre-budget speculators hit India prices.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-Pre-budget speculators hit India prices.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts fell across the board on Monday in thin follow-through selling from last week's drop ahead of the budget announcement.
"The fall is no real surprise. The market will be weak tomorrow but levels won't remain here. It will rally before the budget," one trader said.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI fell 1.77 points to close at 67.18, with a premium over the local market of 16.41 percent.
The Bombay Stock Exchange 30-share index had ended the day down just over 79 points at 3,360.
Most prices were off their highs on light speculative selling though few traders expect much startling from the budget for 1997/98, to be presented on February 28.
East India Hotels was down 50 cents at $16.75 while the Steel Authority dropped $1 to $8.745.
On other Asian GDR markets, the Capel Korea GDR Index fell 1.62 percent to 58.63, with a preimum over the local market of 36.77 percent.
The fall was in line with a drop in the Seoul market where prices were hit by rising interest rates.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index was also lower, easing 0.82 percent to 103.71, with the preimium at 2.50 percent.
